title: potentilla drummondii subsp. breweri
intro: Potentilla drummondii subsp. breweri, commonly known as Drummond's cinquefoil, is a perennial plant species native to the western United States and Canada. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla drummondii subsp. breweri include antimicrobial, antiviral, and antifungal properties, which can help to combat infections and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may have potential health benefits when used in traditional medicine.
